lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨੑ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagat udhaaran saadh prabh tinh laagahu paal ||
lines.translation: God's Holy people are the saviors of the world; I grab hold of the hem of their robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਗ ਰਾਲ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mo kau deejai daan prabh sa(n)tan pag raal ||2||
lines.translation: Bless me, O God, with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: ukat siaanap kachh nahee naahee kachh ghaal ||
lines.translation: I have no skill or wisdom at all, nor any work to my credit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੋਹ ਤੇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bhai raakhahu moh te kaatahu jam jaal ||3||
lines.translation: Please, protect me from doubt, fear and emotional attachment, and cut away the noose of Death from my neck. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: binau karau karunaapate pitaa pratipaal ||
lines.translation: I beg of You, O Lord of Mercy, O my Father, please cherish me!

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavau tere saadhasa(n)g naanak sukh saal ||4||11||41||
lines.translation: I sing Your Glorious Praises, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Lord, Home of peace. ||4||11||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa loRahi so karahi tujh bin kachh naahi ||
lines.translation: Whatever You wish, You do. Without You, there is nothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: parataap tumhaaraa dekh kai jamadoot chhad jaahi ||1||
lines.translation: Gazing upon Your Glory, the Messenger of Death leaves and goes away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumhree kripaa te chhooteeai binasai aha(n)mev ||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, one is emancipated, and egotism is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa samarath prabh poore guradev ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: God is omnipotent, possessing all powers; He is obtained through the Perfect, Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat khojiaa naamai bin koor ||
lines.translation: Searching, searching, searching - without the Naam, everything is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan sukh sabh saadhasa(n)g prabh manasaa poor ||2||
lines.translation: All the comforts of life are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; God is the Fulfiller of desires. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਭ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit jit laavahu tit tit lagahi siaanap sabh jaalee ||
lines.translation: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; I have burnt away all my cleverness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਮੑ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jat kat tumh bharapoor hahu mere deen daiaalee ||3||
lines.translation: You are permeating and pervading everywhere, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh tum te maaganaa vadabhaagee paae ||
lines.translation: I ask for everything from You, but only the very fortunate ones obtain it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee aradaas prabh jeevaa gun gaae ||4||12||42||
lines.translation: This is Nanak's prayer, O God, I live by singing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||12||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਾਸਬੈ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਨਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai baasabai kalamal sabh nasanaa ||
lines.translation: Dwelling in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sins are erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prabh setee ra(n)g raatiaa taa te garabh na grasanaa ||1||
lines.translation: One who is attuned to the Love of God, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਭਈ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam kahat govi(n)d kaa soochee bhaee rasanaa ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, the tongue becomes holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan niramal hoee hai gur kaa jap japanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The mind and body become immaculate and pure, chanting the Chant of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਤ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਹਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakhat dhraapiaa man ras lai hasanaa ||
lines.translation: Tasting the subtle essence of the Lord, one is satisfied; receiving this essence, the mind becomes happy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਉਲਟਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: budh pragaas pragat bhaee ulat kamal bigasanaa ||2||
lines.translation: The intellect is brightened and illuminated; turning away from the world, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: seetal saa(n)t sa(n)tokh hoi sabh boojhee trisanaa ||
lines.translation: He is cooled and soothed, peaceful and content; all his thirst is quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dah dis dhaavat mit gae niramal thaan basanaa ||3||
lines.translation: The mind's wandering in the ten directions is stopped, and one dwells in the immaculate place. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakhanahaarai raakhiaa bhae bhram bhasanaa ||
lines.translation: The Savior Lord saves him, and his doubts are burnt to ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan naanak sukhee pekh saadh darasanaa ||4||13||43||
lines.translation: Nanak is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He finds peace, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan. ||4||13||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: paanee pakhaa pees daas kai tab hohi nihaal ||
lines.translation: Carry water for the Lord's slave, wave the fan over him, and grind his corn; then, you shall be happy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raaj milakh sikadaareeaa aganee mahi jaal ||1||
lines.translation: Burn in the fire your power, property and authority. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kaa chhoharaa tis charanee laag ||
lines.translation: Grasp hold of the feet of the servant of the humble Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਛੋਡਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaadhaaree chhatrapat tinh chhodau tiaag ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Renounce and abandon the wealthy, the regal overlords and kings. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਰੂਖਾ ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan kaa daanaa rookhaa so sarab nidhaan ||
lines.translation: The dry bread of the Saints is equal to all treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਛਤੀਹ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਖੂ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: grihi saakat chhateeh prakaar te bikhoo samaan ||2||
lines.translation: The thirty-six tasty dishes of the faithless cynic, are just like poison. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਲੂਗਰਾ ਓਢਿ ਨਗਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kaa loogaraa odh nagan na hoee ||
lines.translation: Wearing the old blankets of the humble devotees, one is not naked.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਰੇਸਮੀ ਪਹਿਰਤ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saakat sirapaau resamee pahirat pat khoee ||3||
lines.translation: But by putting on the silk clothes of the faithless cynic, one loses one's honor. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰਿਐ ਅਧ ਵੀਚਹੁ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat siu mukh joriai adh veechahu tootai ||
lines.translation: Friendship with the faithless cynic breaks down mid-way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਇਤ ਊਤਹਿ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: har jan kee sevaa jo kare it ootahi chhootai ||4||
lines.translation: But whoever serves the humble servants of the Lord, is emancipated here and hereafter. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh tumh hee te hoaa aap banat banaaee ||
lines.translation: Everything comes from You, O Lord; You Yourself created the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੪॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: darasan bhetat saadh kaa naanak gun gaaee ||5||14||44||
lines.translation: Blessed with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||14||44||
